weeks.title: Advanced Grammar: Greetings and identity
weeks.instructor_overview: Introduce and develop greetings and identity within the context of Advanced Grammar. Use explicit instruction, worked examples or models, guided practice, and independent application.
learning_objectives: Use appropriate language structures and vocabulary for greetings and identity.
Demonstrate comprehension through speaking, listening, reading, or writing.
Apply the language in a culturally appropriate context.

Answer a short retrieval question from the previous week.

Teacher modeling and guided examples for greetings and identity
Collaborative practice involving greetings and identity
Independent application and reflection

learning_objectives: Use appropriate language structures and vocabulary for numbers, dates, and time.
Demonstrate comprehension through speaking, listening, reading, or writing.
Apply the language in a culturally appropriate context.
warm_up: Recall one idea related to numbers, dates, and time.
Answer a short retrieval question from the previous week.
Write one question you expect this week's lesson to answer.
lesson_content: Introduction to Numbers, dates, and time
Teacher modeling and guided examples for numbers, dates, and time
Collaborative practice involving numbers, dates, and time
Independent application and reflection

weeks.title: Classical Culture — Review & Module Assessment
weeks.instructor_overview: Review the major concepts from Classical Culture, address misconceptions, and prepare students for the 30-question module assessment.
learning_objectives: Summarize the major learning from Classical Culture.
Demonstrate mastery of the module's essential skills.
Use assessment feedback to identify areas for remediation.
warm_up: List three ideas you can now explain confidently.
Identify one concept that still needs review.
Explain how two module concepts connect.
lesson_content: Concept review and retrieval practice
Guided analysis of representative problems/texts/tasks
Correction of common misconceptions
Assessment preparation and strategy
